title: Update default description template with shape-specific story variations

requirements.text: In the backend (backend/main.mo), update the default description template stored in the DescriptionTemplates stable storage to use the following base text: 'Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'. If a default template already exists (e.g. created during initialisation), update its content to this new text. If none exists, create it with the name 'Default'.

quotes: Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊
make this the preset description for all items , save in templates

acceptanceCriteria: The description template with name 'Default' exists in backend storage with the exact text: 'Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'
Calling getDescriptionTemplates() returns at least one template containing this text
The template is visible in Dashboard > Description Templates

requirements.text:
In the backend (backend/main.mo), create four additional shape-specific description templates in the DescriptionTemplates stable storage during initialisation (or via a one-time seeding check), one for each of the four preset shapes: Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, and Whale. Each template must weave a short story connecting the shape to melody and the ocarina experience, built on top of the base text from REQ-136. Use the following content:

- Name: 'Turtle' — Content: 'Like the turtle's steady journey through calm waters, this ocarina sings a melody that is patient, rich, and full of depth. Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original Turtle ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'
- Name: 'Dolphin' — Content: 'Inspired by the dolphin's playful leaps and joyful calls, this ocarina carries a bright, flowing melody that dances through the air. Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original Dolphin ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'
- Name: 'Frog' — Content: 'Like the frog's cheerful evening chorus rising from the pond, this ocarina rings out with a warm, lively melody that fills any space with charm. Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original Frog ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'
- Name: 'Whale' — Content: 'Echoing the whale's deep, haunting song across open oceans, this ocarina delivers a resonant, soulful melody that moves the heart. Experience clear, rich sound and precise tuning with this unique, original Whale ocarina. Get instant access to our Pro Learning App, a digital ocarina to jam with, and free postage – a perfect blend of tradition and tech 😊'

quotes: make description from current preset shape (turtle, dolphin, frog, whale)

acceptanceCriteria: Four templates named 'Turtle', 'Dolphin', 'Frog', and 'Whale' are visible in Dashboard > Description Templates
Each template contains a short shape-to-melody story paragraph followed by the base description text
Calling getDescriptionTemplates() returns all four shape templates plus the default template
Templates do not duplicate if the backend is redeployed (seeding check prevents re-creation)

requirements.text: Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to set the default selected template in the template dropdown to the 'Default' template (from REQ-136) when the component first loads, replacing the previously hardcoded description string. When the user changes the selected template from the dropdown, all product description fields that have not been manually edited should update to display the newly selected template's content. The four shape-specific templates (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale) must appear as selectable options in the same dropdown alongside the Default template.

quotes: make this the preset description for all items
make description from current preset shape (turtle, dolphin, frog, whale)

acceptanceCriteria: On load, the template dropdown defaults to the 'Default' template and all description fields are pre-populated with the base text
The dropdown lists at minimum: Default, Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale templates
Selecting 'Dolphin' from the dropdown populates all unedited description fields with the Dolphin-specific template text
Manually edited description fields are not overwritten when the template selection changes
When auto-copy is enabled and the first item's description is the selected template text, changing the template updates all subsequent items' descriptions accordingly

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend hook files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor
Template seeding must be idempotent — do not create duplicate templates on repeated deployments
nonGoals: Changing any other existing description templates already saved by the trader
Adding new shape types beyond the four specified (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale)
Automatically assigning a shape-specific template based on the product's shape field — the trader selects the template manually from the dropdown
